E&R Engineering.why: Laser and plasma tool maker targeting glass-core TGV, glass-carrier debonding and FOPLP processes for AI advanced packaging; substrate and packaging capex drives its tool sales.
E&R Engineering.evidence: E&R Engineering press release (04-29-2026): FOPLP (700 x 700 mm) total solution incl. laser debonding and plasma dry etching for separation of glass carrier and panel; release 1722578 (08-17-2026): Glass Core TGV process, Glass Carrier Debonding & Descum Solution.

players.product: Laser process equipment (TGV glass-core drilling, glass cutting with ABF grooving, glass-carrier laser debonding, laser marking) and microwave/RF plasma equipment (cleaning, descum, de-smear, dry etch, plasma dicing) for glass-core substrates and fan-out panel-level packaging (700 x 700 mm)

quarterly_data.quarter: E&R Engineering press release: Leading the AI Wave: E&R Brings Next-Gen Laser and Plasma (04-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 technology highlights (company release, SEMICON SEA showcase): high-precision laser drilling for 2.5D/3D ICs (±5 μm, B/T ratio up to 90%), multi-beam laser marking (±25 μm accuracy), controlled thermal laser cutting, microwave or RF plasma cleaning for pre-underfill, surface activation and Redox, hybrid plasma dry etching; FOPLP total solution for 700 × 700 mm panels (laser marking, laser cutting, laser descum, plasma cleaning, post-drill de-smear, warpage control up to 16 mm) plus laser debonding and plasma dry etching for separating glass carrier and panel; targets AI and CPO demand; showcased with Horng Terng Automation and Group Up Industrial as an integrated turnkey solution
